description: Add a 'TrendingScore' property (type DOUBLE) to the 'Hotels' class in the 'demodb' database. Then, calculate and populate this property for every hotel with the average star rating of its 5 MOST RECENT reviews. If a hotel has fewer than 5 reviews, average all of them. Use OrientDB Studio (http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html) or the console to perform the schema change and data update. Credentials: root / GymAnything123!
